# PDF dependency

`pdf-lib.esm.min.js` is the unmodified ESM distribution of pdf-lib 1.17.1, downloaded from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pdf-lib@1.17.1/dist/pdf-lib.esm.min.js on 2026-11-03. MIT license: `pdf-lib.LICENSE.md`.

Vendored so packet assembly never downloads executable code at runtime. Used by the Pages server to generate statements, flatten completed application fields, and merge owner uploads. Preserve original signed source files: merged copies do not preserve cryptographic PDF signatures.
